esql: from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where to_lower(gen_ai.output.messages) like "*spcanary-*" and not to_lower(service.name) == "allowlisted-canary-selftest" and to_lower(gen_ai.output.messages) like "*spcanary-7f3c9a1e5b2d*" and not (gen_ai.input.messages is not null and to_lower(gen_ai.input.messages) like "*spcanary-7f3c9a1e5b2d*")
golang_expr: lower(gen_ai?.output?.messages) contains lower("SPCANARY-") and not (lower(service?.name) == lower("allowlisted-canary-selftest")) and lower(gen_ai?.output?.messages) contains lower("SPCANARY-7f3c9a1e5b2d") and not (gen_ai?.input?.messages != nil and lower(gen_ai?.input?.messages) contains lower("SPCANARY-7f3c9a1e5b2d"))
sqlite: SELECT * FROM <TABLE_NAME> WHERE (`gen_ai.output.messages` LIKE '%SPCANARY-%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT `service.name`='allowlisted-canary-selftest')) AND (`gen_ai.output.messages` LIKE '%SPCANARY-7f3c9a1e5b2d%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT (`gen_ai.input.messages` IS NOT NULL AND `gen_ai.input.messages` LIKE '%SPCANARY-7f3c9a1e5b2d%' ESCAPE '\')))
